booking.howItWorks: Tee times (bays) are booked online through foreUP ("Book A Tee Time"); reservations are required. For events, parties, memberships and club fittings, contact owner Brandon Schider at 262-875-3066.

packages.name: Simulator Bay Rental
packages.description: Hourly simulator play. Monday to Thursday $38.09 + tax per hour; Friday to Sunday $47.62 + tax per hour. Daily discounts when booking online. Minimum play: 1 person 1 hour; 2 people 2 hours; 3 people 2 hours; 4 people 3 hours.

packages.name: Senior Rate
packages.description: Seniors $35, Monday to Friday before 4:00 PM.

packages.name: Events & Parties
packages.description: We Do Events & Parties! Private party room, corporate events and date-night packages. Contact Brandon Schider for details and pricing.

faq.q: Can we bring outside food or drinks?
faq.a: Outside food and drink are not permitted.
Yes, reservations are required. Book a tee time online through foreUP.

faq.q: Is there a minimum play time?
faq.a: Minimum play: 1 person 1 hour; 2 people 2 hours; 3 people 2 hours; 4 people 3 hours.

faq.q: Do you have food and drinks?
faq.a: We have a full bar with beers, seltzers and spirits, and a small kitchen menu.

faq.q: Do you have a senior rate?
faq.a: Seniors $35, Monday to Friday before 4:00 PM. Senior Monthly membership: $50 upfront plus $20 per hour for 30 days, Monday to Friday 10 AM to 4 PM only, month to month.

VIP $249.99 per month: 20 hours of play per month, extra hours $25 each, up to 3 hours per day, 3 guest passes per visit, BOGO half-off domestic beers while playing, one free Callaway club fitting every 6 months. 6-month minimum, billed monthly, non-refundable. Free punchcard: buy 10 visits, 11th visit free (one free hour).

Yes. Men's Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday nights: $350 per person, $50 deposit, tee-off 6:00 PM. Couples Monday nights: $550 per couple, $100 deposit, 6:00 PM. Weekday Scramble (Wednesday mornings): $300 per person, $50 deposit. Weekend Scramble (Sunday mornings): $350 per person, $50 deposit, 11:00 AM. Senior leagues: $275 per person, $50 deposit, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Deposit due first day. League perks: buy one get one half off domestic beers, 10% off food. For 20-week options contact the club.
